question_add.label: Power cable armoured
question_add.note: Only when this unit's price includes its power cable: Yes when the BoQ says THAT cable is armoured ('armoured', 'armored', 'AL armoured'); No when it says unarmoured. 'None' when it does not say - the cable is then unarmoured.

question_add.label: Communication cable armoured
question_add.note: Only when this unit's price includes its communication / control cable: Yes when the BoQ says THAT cable is armoured; No when it says unarmoured. 'None' when it does not say.

question_add.label: Power cable length as written
question_add.note: A length the BoQ gives for THIS unit's power cable only ('around a distance of 5m', 'up to 15 m'), copied as written. A length written for another item (the piping, the communication cable) is not this one's. Leave it out when none is stated for the power cable.

question_add.label: Communication cable length as written
question_add.note: A length the BoQ gives for THIS unit's communication / control cable only, copied as written. A length written for the power cable or the piping is not this one's. Leave it out when none is stated for it.

question_add.label: Copper piping length as written
question_add.note: A length the BoQ gives for THIS unit's refrigerant copper piping only ('up to 15 m', 'first 10 RMT'), copied as written. A length written for a cable is not this one's. Leave it out when none is stated for the piping.

question_notes_append.item: VRF-7: a treated fresh air unit (TFA / fresh air unit) is 'Single Skin Treated Fresh Air', even when the BoQ also calls it CSU or ceiling suspended.
question_notes_append.cooling: VRF-7: a unit the BoQ describes for cooling and heating together (cooling/heating, cooling or heating or both, cooling as well as heating) is 'Heat Pump'. The row's own cooling type wins over a heading.
question_notes_append.discharge: VRF-7: as the BoQ states it anywhere for this unit - the row, its notes, a heading or note above ('top discharge', 'side discharge', 'top throw'). 'None' when nothing states it.
question_notes_append.includes_comm: VRF-7: decide from the BoQ's words at EVERY level above the row (the row, its heading, the heading above that, the sheet's notes) whether the control / communication cabling is in this unit's scope. A sentence about how the system must behave when the control wiring fails or breaks down is NOT scope. A heading or note at any level that puts the control wiring in the scope IS scope.
question_notes_append.includes_remote: VRF-7: a unit supplied with or without a remote as the client requires counts as Yes (the remote is priced in). An individual controller for the units of a system means one remote per indoor unit: Yes.
question_notes_append.includes_copper: VRF-7: interconnecting piping named in a unit's heading or note is the copper piping stated: Yes.
question_notes_append.includes_insulation: VRF-7: suction line insulation named in a unit's heading or note is the insulation stated: Yes.
